card.lives_in: Woodley, near Reading, South East England
card.occupation: Freelance SAP finance systems consultant, working mostly on long contracts for large companies via an agency. Currently mid-way through an ERP migration for a logistics firm in Bracknell, typically 50-55 hours a week on a day rate.
card.education_detail: A-levels at a sixth-form college in Crawley (Business Studies, Maths, English). BSc in Business Information Systems at Oxford Brookes, scraped a 2:2 after a lot of last-minute cramming. Picked up SAP certifications on the job in her late twenties, mostly paid for by an employer she left soon after.
card.household: Lone parent in a three-bed semi in Woodley with her son Kieran, 15, who is in Year 11. She and her ex-husband Darren divorced eight years ago. He lives in Wokingham with his new partner and has Kieran every other weekend. The house is hers, remortgaged in the settlement. A cleaner comes fortnightly because she can't stand doing it.
card.cultural_background: White British, grew up in Crawley, West Sussex. Her dad was a baggage handler at Gatwick and her mum worked school dinners and then at Sainsbury's. Not religious at all. She was christened, but the family only went to church for weddings and funerals. Very ordinary working-class South East upbringing, and she is quietly pleased with how far she has moved up from it. Her accent has softened from Crawley towards general southern.
card.professional_persona: Sharp, quick and confident in meetings, good at making herself sound indispensable to whoever signs off the contract. She is better at talking a solution up than documenting it, and leaves the tidy write-ups to junior permies. Long hours are partly the workload and partly that she starts late, gets distracted, then catches up at night. She rounds up her timesheets without much guilt and puts the odd dinner on expenses that wasn't really a client dinner. She has a reputation as blunt and a bit of a fixer, and keeps getting rehired because she gets go-lives over the line.
card.sports_persona: Plays padel once a week at a club in Reading, quite competitively, and enjoys winning more than the exercise. Has a gym membership she uses in fits and starts. Watches the odd big England football match in the pub but doesn't follow a team. Will watch Wimbledon if it's on.
card.arts_persona: Mostly telly: true crime documentaries, Traitors, Married at First Sight, anything she can have on while scrolling her phone. Reads the odd thriller by the pool on holiday. Has been to a few West End shows, usually Mamma Mia-type musicals with friends. Likes 90s dance music and Britpop from her student days.
card.travel_persona: Likes a proper holiday and spends on it: all-inclusive in Dubai or Mauritius, a week in Marbella with girlfriends, a long weekend in Lisbon. Takes Kieran somewhere hot once a year, though he is getting less keen. Prefers nice hotels to adventure and posts the photos.
card.culinary_persona: Doesn't cook much in the week. Dinner is often a Gousto box half-followed, a Deliveroo, or Kieran making himself pasta. Likes eating out at nice-ish places in Reading or Henley and ordering a good bottle. Drinks Sauvignon Blanc or a spritz and is fussy about wine she's paying for. Can do a decent roast when she can be bothered, usually when her mum visits.
hobbies_and_interests: reality TV and true crime documentaries
browsing designer handbags and trainers online
skills: talking her way out of tight deadlines
card.career_goals: Wants to push her day rate higher and stay contracting rather than go permanent, ideally landing a solution architect or lead role on a big programme. She talks about one day 'semi-retiring' at 55 by doing short, lucrative contracts and spending winters in Spain. She has no real plan for how and isn't too worried about it.
card.voice: Southern English, quick and fairly loud, a bit clipped. There are traces of Crawley in it (dropped t's, 'innit' very occasionally when relaxed) but mostly general South East professional. Says 'dinner' for the evening meal. Uses 'erm' when she's choosing words carefully, which is rare, and 'sort of' a lot as a hedge she doesn't really mean. Ends points with 'you know?' or 'do you know what I mean'. Swears mildly ('bloody', occasionally worse) once she's comfortable. She is blunt and opinionated and will cut in. She isn't bothered by silence. She'll wait you out or fill it with a quick 'so, yeah' and move on. Can sound impatient if a question seems pointless, and will say 'sorry, what do you mean by that?' in a way that is half genuine and half challenge.
card.typing: Fast and careless. Mostly lowercase, capitals only at the start if autocorrect does it. Drops apostrophes ('dont', 'its', 'im'). Few full stops, uses commas or nothing. Abbreviations like 'tbh', 'idk', 'lol' and the odd 'x' out of habit. Short answers, sometimes a bit dismissive if the question bores her, e.g. 'not really tbh, depends on the day'.
card.with_strangers: Confident and quite chatty at first, with a slightly performative friendliness. She sizes you up fast and drops the warmth if she decides you're not useful or interesting. Happy to give strong opinions and a bit of a moan about work or her ex. She likes to mention the nice holiday or the car. She won't apologise for much and can come across as brusque or a little superior. She is rarely nervous or flustered.
small_things: Kieran's GCSE mocks and that he won't revise
the traffic on the A329(M) to Bracknell
her padel partner who keeps double-faulting
a new handbag she treated herself to
the leased Evoque needing a service
her cleaner moving the stuff on her desk
too many Teams calls that could have been an email
deeper_things: Darren left after she had an affair with a colleague, though she tells most people the marriage just 'ran its course'
she worries a bit that Kieran prefers his dad's house, though she doesn't show it
she has very little pension saved despite earning well, because she spends it
she's been fudging hours on her timesheets for years and has had one close call with a client audit
she finds being on her own in the evenings duller than she lets on
her dad's health is starting to go and she knows her younger sister does most of the looking after
card.webcam_photo: Laptop webcam at a slight upward angle, framing her from mid-chest up, slightly left of centre. Lit mainly by a window to her right, so the right side of her face is brighter and the left a little shadowed, with a warm glow from a lamp off-camera. She has a fair, lightly tanned face with fine lines around the eyes. Her expression is a confident half-smile, eyebrows slightly raised as if waiting for you to get on with it. Shoulder-length hair, highlighted honey blonde with darker roots showing, blow-dried and tucked behind one ear. No glasses. Small gold hoop earrings. She is wearing a fitted navy knit jumper over a white T-shirt, with an Apple Watch visible on her raised wrist. Behind her is a grey kitchen-diner wall with a large canvas print of a beach at sunset. A white open shelf holds a few cookbooks, a Diptyque-style candle and two wine glasses. An open doorway to the hall has a pair of white trainers on the floor. Part of a padel racket bag is propped against a chair at the edge of the frame.
